name: Fieldset
purpose: Group related form controls under native fieldset and legend semantics while sharing group state and validation behavior.
useWhen: Multiple related controls need one group question or label, especially radio or checkbox choices.

avoidWhen.condition: Only one control needs a label.

composition: Compose Fieldset.Root -> Fieldset.Legend -> optional description/error -> Fields or grouped controls.

rules.statement: Group only controls that answer one related question.
Provide a meaningful legend unless an equivalent documented accessible naming strategy is required.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using one Field to label a collection of controls.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Fieldset for the group and Field for each independently labeled control.

validation: Confirm disabled, required, and invalid group state reaches descendants as documented.
